title: DishPlay Scan calculator -> client messages
description: JSON events on WS /sessions/{id}/events. Geometry itself is binary DPG1 (see backend/reconstruction/preview_format.py) fetched from the URL in a geometry event; the client keeps only the newest version and ignores older ones.

active.description: A calculation process is working on this session right now. The socket belongs to the session, not to the process: events arrive as soon as a process starts. After hello the calculator sends the last known status and geometry of the session.

state.description: queued: the final calculation of this session waits its turn (one calculation at a time; it starts by itself). failed: the final calculation ended without a model; a new finish request starts it again.

queue_position.description: With state queued: place in the line, 1 = next.

error.description: With state failed: one short French sentence for the person.

message.description: For the person. When a final calculation fails this is a French sentence, and a status with state failed follows.

detail.description: Technical detail (for the log, not for the person).

version.description: Strictly increasing within a session. Final geometry uses 1000000 + n.

classes.description: 0 measured (>=2 views), 1 interpolated by fusion, 2 estimated (completion, off by default), 3 tracking (client only), 4 provisional single-view.
